name: Bottlecraft Little Italy
notes: Bottlecraft is a craft beer bottle shop and bar; this capture is the full 24-tap draft list (TapHunter widget embedded on the restaurant's own bottlecraft.com/locations/little-italy-beer-shop/ page), each beer listed with its priced pour sizes (4oz/8oz/16oz as offered). Confirmed complete: the widget's own heading says 'Draft List (24)' and all 24 rows were captured. Data was current as of the page's own 'Updated August 29' timestamp. Did not capture the separate hundreds-strong retail bottle/can inventory (take-home beer, wine, cider, kombucha) since that is a large retail product catalog rather than a drink menu, and is not exposed as a distinct priced list on the site the way the tap menu is.
